items.title: Willie Hightower Interview, 1958-06-03
items.q: He was this older man than Bud Scott. ... Can't think of his name.

ctx.x: No, it wasn't Bud Scott, no. Bud Scott, no. Bud Scott wasn't John. He was this older man than Bud Scott.
Yeah, he was an old fellow. Very sensible fellow. Great man. Can't think of his name. Wasn't Brock? No. What?
